rationale: Stage13 and G5 own source/rest geometry fidelity; Stage14 selects a bounded mechanical carrier without changing dense zero-surface authority.
No v1 quality tolerance was relaxed. The only search-budget change is max_candidate_nodes 8192 -> 12288.
12288 was justified by subject-free mechanical-capacity evidence and exact current Geppetto encoder FP32 forward/backward/AdamW feasibility on A100.
Every self-visible dense connected component is eligible regardless of dense-vertex fraction, closing the demonstrated tiny-visible-component escape.
Voxel compaction preserves dense connected-component identity, closing cross-component aliasing at negligible node-count cost.
mutation_rule: After any new Knight Stage14 result is inspected, this policy may only be tightened prospectively; quality tolerances may never be relaxed to convert a failure into PASS. Search-budget changes require new subject-free capacity and compute evidence.
claim_boundary: This policy does not claim Knight compliance, Stage14 PASS, Stage15 PASS, Geppetto fit PASS, or PRODUCT_PASS.
